subject: Follow-up: Data access evidence & audit log exports
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finosolutions.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Data access evidence & audit log exports

Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the security review: 

Summary of what you asked for (as I heard it):
- A sample export showing "who accessed what, when" for model inference and config access (action-level audit).
- Schema and sample payloads for access logs (CSV/parquet preferred).
- Clarification on PII handling: whether any user input is persisted, how we mask/identify users in logs, and identity mapping options.
- Data residency for logs (ability to keep audit exports in us-east-1).
- Retention policy and the mechanics for long-term retention (you mentioned 7+ years for regulatory reasons).

What we can deliver in the short term:
- A 72-hour sample export (redacted) showing token-level access events and admin config changes. File format: CSV with columns we discussed (timestamp, principal, action, resource_id, request_id, session_ip, geo, note).
- A short document with our access-log schema and masking rules (what we redact vs. what we persist).
- Confirmation of export locations and a proposal to stage the evidence in a customer-only Google Drive folder in us-east-1.

Asks for you:
1) Can you attach the audit template you want us to fill (if different from the list above)?
2) Any specific column names or compliance fields we should include (e.g., requestor_employee_id vs. user_email)?
3) Timing constraints — you mentioned needing this for an internal review next week; is EOD Thu (PDT) acceptable for the sample?

Next steps I propose: I’ll hand this to Tessa (cc’d) to assemble the sample export and the schema doc. Laura (cc’d) will review any legal/retention language if we need to commit to a contract clause. I’ll loop back with a packaged evidence bundle and a calendar invite for a short walkthrough.

Thanks — Alex

Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finosolutions.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finos Solutions Security <security@finosolutions.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Data access evidence & audit log exports

Alex — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming a few priority items from our side: 

Priority checklist (for our audit team):
- Access events must include the authenticated principal (we map to internal SSO id, so requestor_employee_id is preferred over email).
- Event IDs (request_id) are required so we can trace a sequence across systems.
- Ability to identify whether the request returned user content that contained PII (flag column OK — we allow masked content in samples).
- Export in both CSV and parquet would be ideal (parquet for our analytics team).
- Residency: logs must be exportable and persistable in us-east-1 only for the evidence bundle; long-term retention (7 years) will be discussed with procurement but we need the mechanism.

I've attached our standard audit template — it lists the fields our compliance team expects. If you can fill the template and produce a 72-hour sample (redacted/pseudonymized) by COB Thu (your time) that would meet our internal review schedule. If you need extra time we can push the review by 48 hours but would prefer sooner.

Thanks,
Samir

--
Samir Patel
Senior Security Program Manager, Finos Solutions
samir.patel@finosolutions.com
Attachment: Finos_Audit_Template.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finosolutions.com>, Finos Solutions Security <security@finosolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Data access evidence & audit log exports

Alex / Laura — taking this on. Notes and proposed deliverables: 

Technical note: we do not persist raw customer inputs long-term by default; inference inputs are transient in the serving runtime but we produce operational audit records that reference request metadata (request_id, principal, timestamp, model, prompt_hash). For compliance packages we can create a sanitized export that either: (A) includes pseudonymized user ids (requestor_id) and a PII-flag column, or (B) includes full user_email if the customer provides a signed request and confirms retention/regulatory need.

Proposed short-term evidence bundle (72-hour sample):
- redwood-audit-evidence-sample.csv — columns: timestamp, request_id, principal_id, action, model, prompt_hash, response_size, pii_flag, resource_id, session_ip, geo
- redwood-access-log-schema.md — human-readable definitions for each column and our redaction rules
- A mapping file that shows how internal SSO ids map to customer-provided employee ids (we will pseudonymize unless you authorize full mapping)

Export format: CSV (canonical) + Parquet (analytics). Delivery: upload to a customer-only Drive folder in us-east-1 and share link.

Questions for Legal (Laura):
- If Finos requires the export to contain full user_emails for retention, do we need a contractual amendment to specify retention and liability?
- Are there any export encryption-at-rest requirements beyond our standard transfer encryption?

I'll prepare the sample and schema and aim to share the Drive link by 11:30 PDT Thu. Attaching the log schema doc for internal review.

Thanks — Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-access-log-schema.md

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Data access evidence & audit log exports

Samir — quick update and delivery plan. Per Tessa we can provide the following by EOB today (PDT):

Deliverables (to be uploaded to a customer-only Drive folder in us-east-1):
- redwood-audit-evidence-sample.csv (72-hour redacted export)
- redwood-access-log-schema.md (definitions + masking rules)
- short cover note that maps our columns to your template (we will populate Finos_Audit_Template.xlsx and attach it)

Links: share folder (will be private and link-shared only to the emails on this thread): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-Redwood-Finos-Audit
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (deal RDW-2026-0297)
Schedule: I'll send a 30-min walkthrough invite for Fri 09:00 PDT to review the sample with your compliance team. If that doesn't work, please propose two alternate times.

Notes on retention/residency: Laura will draft the recommended contract language we normally use for retention commitments and will flag any exceptions. Tessa — please keep the mapping pseudonymized until Laura confirms there is an executed amendment.

Action items: 
- Tessa: upload evidence bundle + populate Finos_Audit_Template.xlsx (attachment).
- Laura: review retention language and advise on whether a PO/Amendment is required.
- Samir: confirm that the CSV schema covers your fields or call out any additional columns.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Alex Martinez
